court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: Family Court, Madurai, H.M.O.P.Nos.526 and 604 of 2012
facts_of_case: Petitioner filed for annulment of marriage under Section 12(1)(c) of the Hindu Marriage Act, claiming consent was obtained by force. Respondent claimed they had a relationship before marriage and were living together in Singapore. Trial court dismissed petition for annulment and allowed petition for restitution of conjugal rights.

legal_principles.principle: The court will not hunt for evidence to prove a physical relationship.
legal_principles.held: If the appellant and the respondent had stayed in the same room at Singapore, it is not necessary to hunt for evidence to prove that they had physical relationship.

legal_principles.principle: The court will not suppress vital facts in a case.
legal_principles.held: This issue has been properly addressed by the Court below and the Court below has commented upon the suppression of this vital fact by the appellant, which was put against him.

outcome.final_order: The appeals are allowed, and the common order passed by the Family Court is set aside.

use_for_drafting: assisting with restoration of conjugal rights
